handback.title: Planner's test limits and docstrings follow settings
handback.summary: The planner's check reads its time limit, test files and docstring rules from the repo's settings.
handback.user_story: A repo's time limit, test file pattern and docstring rules decide what the planner's check accepts.

acceptance_criteria.text: The check that new tests fail today stops a test after the time limit setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: The check that new tests fail today stops a test after the time limit setting.

edge_cases.case: A test that ends within the limit is not stopped.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's test files are found by the test folder and file pattern settings.
acceptance_criteria.words: The planner's test files are found by the test folder and file pattern settings.

edge_cases.case: A helper file in the test folder that does not match the pattern.

acceptance_criteria.text: Turning docstrings off in settings stops the planner's check requiring them.
acceptance_criteria.words: Turning docstrings off in settings stops the planner's check requiring them.

edge_cases.case: With no settings file, docstrings stay required.

acceptance_criteria.text: The planner's test docstring cap comes from settings.
acceptance_criteria.words: The planner's test docstring cap comes from settings.

edge_cases.case: A docstring under the set cap still passes.

acceptance_criteria.text: An empty planner test docstring cap turns that cap off.
acceptance_criteria.words: An empty planner test docstring cap turns that cap off.

edge_cases.case: With no settings file, the shipped cap still applies.
